bread.name: Warm sourdough
bread.description: Restore 2 hearts. H to eat a loaf on the trail.

tea.name: Meadow tea
tea.description: Restore 2 hearts and refresh Wind Slash.

honey.name: Valley honey
honey.description: Restore 3 hearts. A little sweetness for the road.

bandit_badge.name: Bandit badge
bandit_badge.description: Recovered from a defeated bandit. Bring three to Bram.

travel_sword.name: Traveller’s sword
travel_sword.description: Your trusty blade. Space to strike; Q for Wind Slash.

warden_charm.name: Warden’s charm
warden_charm.description: Equip to gain one extra maximum heart. A gift from Bram.

traveller_tunic.name: Traveller's tunic
traveller_tunic.description: Soft linen and a leather harness. A familiar companion on the road.

field_trousers.name: Field trousers
field_trousers.description: Olive wool, roomy pockets and patched knees.

riding_gloves.name: Riding gloves
riding_gloves.description: Supple fingerless gloves with a sure grip.

trail_boots.name: Trail boots
trail_boots.description: Well-worn leather boots for long woodland walks.

leather_cap.name: Scout leather cap
leather_cap.description: A sturdy brow and room for your ears. Adds one maximum heart.

reinforced_vest.name: Emberguard vest
reinforced_vest.description: Tomas stitched tough leather over a soft lining. Adds two maximum hearts.

hunter_boots.name: Pathfinder boots
hunter_boots.description: Light, springy soles. Walk and run ten percent faster.

tempered_sword.name: Embersteel sword
tempered_sword.description: A fine tempered blade, forged in gratitude. Sword strikes deal two damage.

swift_charm.name: Windfeather charm
swift_charm.description: A breeze caught in turquoise. Wind Slash recharges in 4.5 seconds.

smith_tools.name: Tomas's stolen tools
smith_tools.description: A hammer and tongs recovered from Rook. Return them to Tomas at Emberforge in Northgate.
